traits.name: Damage Immunities
traits.description: Immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The werewolf can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies. (Descriptive only: no shapechanger forms. The humanoid form is the authored stat block. Hybrid and wolf, including the wolf form speed 40 and hybrid/wolf AC 12, are not separate statistics. shapechanger: true is the Moonbeam fact. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The werewolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: The werewolf makes two attacks: two with its spear (humanoid form) or one with its bite and one with its claws (hybrid form). (Humanoid form, authored: two spear attacks. Bite + claws are hybrid form. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Bite (Hybrid or Wolf Form Only). Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy. (Descriptive only: not a weapon attack on the authored humanoid form. The lycanthropy curse is not encoded. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Claws (Hybrid Form Only). Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. (Descriptive only: hybrid form only, not a weapon attack on the authored humanoid form. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spear (two hands)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spear (thrown)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
